threat_event: Fraudulent wire sent on instructions from a compromised business customer email account (business email compromise)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Callback to the phone number on file skipped at 2 of 6 branches; 7 of 25 sampled branch wires had no callback evidence
existing_controls: Maker-checker dual control in the wire room; written callback standard
treatment_plan: Mandatory callback for all non-face-to-face wire requests, enforced as a required field in SYS-03; branch refresher training; monthly callback compliance sampling by Deposit Operations

threat_event: Account takeover of a business online banking user who has not enabled MFA, followed by new wire beneficiaries and fraudulent wires or ACH files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer MFA optional (58% of business users enrolled); password-only users can add beneficiaries; beneficiary changes not monitored
existing_controls: Dual approval above $50,000; vendor fraud scoring on logins
treatment_plan: Require MFA for all business users by 2026-12-31 and consumer users by 2027-03-31; out-of-band confirmation for new beneficiaries; alerting on beneficiary and limit changes

threat_event: Core processor outage longer than the 4-hour RTO stops deposit, loan, and payment processing at all branches
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single core processor; contract predates 12 CFR Part 53 and sets no recovery or incident notice terms
existing_controls: Annual participation in the core processor disaster recovery test; branch offline teller mode
treatment_plan: Add recovery time and incident notice terms at the 2027 renewal; designate a 12 CFR 53.4 point of contact now; test branch offline procedures twice a year

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts branch workstations and file shares and disrupts branch service
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat branch networks; file shares on branch servers; backup vault in the same cloud account as production
existing_controls: EDR monitored 24x7 by the MSSP; MFA for remote access; phishing simulations twice a year
treatment_plan: Segment teller, wire-room, and back-office networks; move backups to a separate account with immutable retention; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Insider or former employee uses a stale core account to view customer information or alter account records
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No quarterly core access reviews; 4 enabled accounts of departed employees (P07); bank-level super user roles not reviewed
existing_controls: HR emails IT at termination; unique core logons
treatment_plan: Disable the 4 stale accounts now; quarterly core entitlement reviews signed by managers; super user review by the ISO; same-day disable from HR ticket

threat_event: A notification incident is not reported to the OCC within 36 hours (or to the Federal Reserve for the holding company), leading to supervisory criticism
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Incident response plan lacks the 12 CFR 53.3 step and determination criteria; no 225.302 step
existing_controls: Ad hoc escalation to the CEO
treatment_plan: Add the determination criteria, clock, contacts, and templates to the plan (P08); tabletop exercise

threat_event: Core processor security incident at the provider exposes bank customer information and the bank learns late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC reports not reviewed; CUECs unmapped; no contractual incident notice time frame
existing_controls: SOC reports collected annually
treatment_plan: Review SOC reports and map CUECs (P09); request bridge letters; incident notice terms at renewal

threat_event: Residual risks accepted without reference to board-approved limits, so the board cannot tell whether the program keeps risk within appetite
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No board-approved risk appetite or tolerance thresholds for information security
existing_controls: Annual risk assessment; annual board report
treatment_plan: Draft risk appetite statement with measurable tolerances (this register's acceptance levels); board adoption 2026-10-15

threat_event: Unauthorized change to a wire beneficiary or user limit in the online banking admin console goes unnoticed
threat_source: Workforce member or attacker with admin access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Admin console and wire platform audit logs not reviewed
existing_controls: MFA on admin console; maker-checker on wires
treatment_plan: Daily exception report of beneficiary and limit changes reviewed by Deposit Operations; logs forwarded to the MSSP

threat_event: Wire platform unavailable on a high-volume day and the untested alternate procedure fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alternate wire procedure not tested since 2023
existing_controls: Written alternate procedure; vendor redundancy
treatment_plan: Test the alternate wire procedure twice a year with a live low-value wire

threat_event: AI credit model denies small business applicants with adverse action reasons that are not specific or accurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reason codes not reviewed against 12 CFR 1002.9(b)(2); no independent validation
existing_controls: Loan officer makes the final decision
treatment_plan: Reason-code review by Compliance; validation before expansion (see P10)

threat_event: AI credit model produces outcomes that disadvantage applicants on a prohibited basis through proxy variables
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No fair lending testing before the pilot; vendor model is partly opaque
existing_controls: Pilot limited to 3 branches and loans under $250,000
treatment_plan: Pre-expansion fair lending testing and quarterly monitoring (see P10 bias testing plan)

threat_event: Phishing captures a bank employee's credentials and the attacker uses the mailbox to redirect a customer loan closing payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA push approval can be abused (number matching not enforced); loan documents with NPI kept in mailboxes
existing_controls: Workforce MFA; phishing simulations twice a year; email filtering
treatment_plan: Enforce number matching or phishing-resistant MFA; mailbox forwarding rule alerts; quarterly phishing simulations

threat_event: Hurricane closes branches and the main office operations center for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operations center and wire room in the same building as the main office branch
existing_controls: Business continuity plan; core hosted off-site by the core processor
treatment_plan: Designate Branch 4 as the alternate wire and operations site; pre-stage 2 payments workstations there; annual relocation exercise

threat_event: Laptop with customer loan files lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Loan officers carry laptops to customer sites
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption on all laptops
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: encryption reduces the residual risk to Low

threat_event: Loan documents or statements containing NPI emailed to the wrong recipient
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No outbound data loss prevention; staff email NPI to customers
existing_controls: TLS for email in transit
treatment_plan: Secure document portal for loan files; outbound sensitive-data rule; training

threat_event: ATM compromised by skimming or a logical attack (jackpotting)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 off-site ATMs with limited physical monitoring
existing_controls: Anti-skimming hardware; card processor fraud monitoring; vendor maintenance
treatment_plan: Add tamper alerts and quarterly inspections of off-site ATMs; confirm ATM software lockdown with the maintenance vendor

threat_event: Distributed denial of service makes online banking unavailable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Service is vendor-hosted; bank depends on the provider's protections
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection per its SOC 2 report
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low; provider controls reviewed in P09

threat_event: Insider in the wire room creates and approves a fraudulent wire by colluding with another employee
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Maker-checker enforced, but the 2 approvers can also edit beneficiary templates
existing_controls: Maker-checker; background checks; daily wire reconciliation
treatment_plan: Separate template maintenance from wire approval; monthly review of approver activity by the COO

threat_event: ISO cannot escalate security concerns independently of IT operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ISO is the IT Manager and reports to the COO
existing_controls: ISO presents the annual report to the board
treatment_plan: ISO gets a direct reporting line to the Audit and Risk Committee; evaluate a part-time independent ISO in the 2027 budget

threat_event: Unpatched internet-facing firewall or remote access gateway exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Firmware updates applied quarterly, not on a risk basis
existing_controls: Annual external penetration test; MSSP monitoring
treatment_plan: Monthly vulnerability scans; critical firmware updates within 14 days

threat_event: Cloud tenant misconfiguration exposes the data warehouse containing customer and loan data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No configuration baseline or posture monitoring for the cloud tenant
existing_controls: Private network access only; provider encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Documented baseline and monthly configuration review; enable the provider's posture alerts

threat_event: Customer information on retired workstations or ATM disks recovered after disposal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disposal vendor provides certificates for paper but not for drives
existing_controls: Paper shredding vendor with certificates
treatment_plan: Certified drive destruction with serial-number certificates

threat_event: Digital banking provider incident or outage not communicated to the bank in time to serve customers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No bank-designated point of contact given for 12 CFR 53.4 notices
existing_controls: Provider status page
treatment_plan: Send designated contacts to the core processor, the digital banking provider, and the card processor

threat_event: Mobile deposit or ACH origination used by a customer to move fraudulent funds, undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ACH exposure limits reviewed only at onboarding
existing_controls: Provider fraud scoring; ACH limits per customer
treatment_plan: Annual ACH customer limit review; velocity alerts

threat_event: Staff do not recognize a BEC request or report it quickly, so fund recall chances are lost
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training covers phishing but not payment-fraud red flags; no fraud hotline for staff
existing_controls: Annual training
treatment_plan: Role-based BEC and wire-fraud training for branch and wire staff; one-page red-flag card; 15-minute internal reporting rule

threat_event: Security events in the core are missed because the bank relies on the core processor's monitoring without reviewing reports
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No review of core security reports; CUECs for user activity review unmapped
existing_controls: Core processor monitors its infrastructure
treatment_plan: Monthly review of core user activity and exception reports

threat_event: Key controls are not tested often enough to support the annual board report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Testing limited to the annual IT audit and penetration test
existing_controls: Annual IT audit; annual penetration test
treatment_plan: Add this control assessment (P07) to the annual cycle and report results to the board

threat_event: Customer online banking credentials reused from third-party breaches (credential stuffing)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Optional customer MFA; lockout after 5 attempts
existing_controls: Provider lockout and device fingerprinting
treatment_plan: Covered by required MFA (R-002)

threat_event: Security policies are not followed at branches because procedures are not written
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Policies adopted 2026-08-27; branch procedures pending
existing_controls: Policy acknowledgments at hire
treatment_plan: Branch procedures for wires, access, and incident reporting

threat_event: Payments workstation compromised and used to send a Fedwire message outside SYS-03 controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payments workstations are hardened and isolated, with token-based access
existing_controls: Dedicated hardened workstations on an isolated segment; hardware tokens; EDR
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Moderate is within the COO acceptance level given the hardened and isolated design; revisit at the 2027 assessment

threat_event: Examiner criticism or enforcement because vendor oversight (SOC review, CUECs) is not documented
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC reports collected but not reviewed
existing_controls: SOC reports on file
treatment_plan: Documented annual SOC review for critical vendors (P09 method)
